id: title:Piccirello:allow blob images in the app and admin policies

review.posthog_relevance: Allows browser-side rendering of blob: URLs for image upload previews, replay, and SQL editor while preserving worker-src protections against image exfiltration.
review.reason: P1.F1.H2 adds 'blob:' to the CSP img-src directive, enabling the browser to render locally generated images (e.g., uploaded file previews, SQL query results) while retaining existing protections. P1.F1.H1 is excluded from scoring as it is a maintenance addition without established relationship to P1.F1.H2. No unverified outcomes or adoption metrics are inferred.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on the supplied hunk P1.F1.H2; P1.F1.H1 is omitted. No evidence of actual incident avoidance or adoption is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H2 is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement. P1.F1.H1 is a maintenance addition. No relationship between them is established; treating them as a single group risks over-scoring. P1.F1.H2 is assessed. P1.F1.H1 is omitted from scoring.

observations.behavior: Adds blob: to img-src CSP directive.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows browser to render blob: URLs in admin pages; without it, Django admin and PostHog admin pages lose client-side generated images. This is a maintenance fix, not a systemic capability or risk reduction.

observations.behavior: Adds blob: to img-src CSP directive while retaining https: and other allowed origins.
observations.code_quote: f"img-src 'self' data: blob: https: {resource_url} https://posthog.com https://www.gravatar.com https://res.cloudinary.com https://platform.slack-edge.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com",
observations.posthog_connection: Allows browser to render blob: URLs for image upload previews, replay and SQL editor while still blocking blob: for worker-src. This preserves existing image exfiltration protections while fixing image loss. This is a bounded correctness improvement.
